{{Top|leg}}
'''''Glaser''''' was a [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90]] [[Corvette/Legends|Corvette]] employed by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]]. The corvette was part of a Rebel strike force attacking an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|Frigate]] ''[[Laantis]]'' while it was receiving a new [[Hyperdrive/Legends|Hyperdrive]] engine from the [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Rasvin]]''. The corvette was destroyed in the battle.

==Behind the scenes==
The Glaser, along with a number of [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]] are purple in the CMD. However, there is no indication of who they belong to other then the Rebels.
